housing-numbers.notes: Provision will be made for the development of at least 13,230 dwellings and associated development and infrastructure in the Borough in the period 2006-2026 for which substantial investment in infrastructure will be required. These will be provided in the following phases: April 2006 to March 2011 – 600 dwellings average per annum; April 2011 to March 2016 – 700 dwellings average per annum; April 2016 to March 2021 – 723 dwellings average per annum; April 2021 to March 2026 – 623 dwellings average per annum.
